create_event_storage: create an EventStorage context manager to record and track training metrics like losses, learning rate, and timing
write_scalars_json: write scalar metrics to a JSON file with one JSON object per line for easy parsing and post-training analysis
log_to_tensorboard: log scalar metrics, images, and histograms to TensorBoard for real-time visualization during model training
print_common_metrics: print common training metrics including losses, iteration time, ETA, memory usage, and learning rate to the terminal
record_histogram: record a histogram from a PyTorch tensor and export it to TensorBoard for distribution visualization
